units.source_text: “那是十一月冷雨连绵的一天，我穿着淋湿的大衣，

en.t: It was a cold, rainy day in November, and I was wearing a soaked overcoat,

units.source_text: 像往常那样穿过蒟蒻阎魔堂，走上狭窄的坡路，回到了家里。

en.t: and as usual I passed by Konnyaku Enma, climbed the narrow slope, and returned home.

units.source_text: K的房间里没有人，可火盆里却暖烘烘地燃着新加的炭火。

en.t: There was no one in K's room, but freshly added charcoal was burning warmly in the brazier.

units.source_text: 我也想赶快在红红的炭火上烤烤冰凉的手，便急忙打开自己房间的隔扇。

en.t: Wanting to warm my cold hands quickly over the red coals, I hurriedly opened the sliding partition to my own room.

units.source_text: 可是，我的火盆里只有一堆冰冷的白灰，连火星儿都没有，我立刻感到不快。

en.t: But in my brazier there was only a heap of cold white ash, not even a spark, and I immediately felt displeased.

units.source_text: 这时候，夫人听到我的脚步声，来到我的房间。

en.t: Just then, hearing my footsteps, the lady of the house came to my room.

units.source_text: 她见我默默地站在屋子中间，便心疼地帮我脱下大衣，换上和服。

en.t: Seeing me standing silently in the middle of the room, she took pity on me and helped me off with my overcoat and into Japanese clothes.

units.source_text: 听我说冷，又赶忙从外间把K的火盆搬进来。

en.t: When she heard me say I was cold, she hurriedly brought K's brazier in from the next room.

units.source_text: 我问：‘K已经回来了吗？’夫人说：‘回来又出去了。’

en.t: I asked, 'Has K already come back?' The lady said, 'He came back and went out again.'

units.source_text: 按理说，那天K也应该比我晚回来，我不觉有些奇怪。

en.t: By rights, K should have come back later than I did that day too, so I could not help finding it strange.

units.source_text: 夫人说他大概是有什么事儿吧。

en.t: The lady said he probably had some errand to attend to.
